Boiling Crab Menu: Top Picks for Your Next Craving

If you’re a seafood lover, then Boiling Crab is a restaurant that should definitely be on your radar. Known for its flavorful seafood boils, signature sauces, and finger-licking goodness, Boiling Crab is a go-to spot for anyone craving the freshest seafood with a Cajun twist. Whether you’re planning to order online, get your meal via delivery, or enjoy the atmosphere of a seafood boil at the restaurant, this guide covers everything you need to know about the Boiling Crab menu, including pricing, top dishes, and FAQs.

About Boiling Crab

Founded in 2004 in California, Boiling Crab has grown into one of the most popular seafood boil chains in the United States. With a focus on Cajun-inspired flavors, their menu is built around fresh seafood, bold spices, and mouthwatering sauces that enhance the natural flavor of the seafood. Whether you’re after shrimp, crawfish, lobster, or crab legs, the Boiling Crab menu has something to satisfy your cravings.

The Boiling Crab Menu Overview

At Boiling Crab, you can enjoy an assortment of seafood, ranging from shrimp and crawfish to king crab and lobster. Each order is made-to-order and seasoned with your choice of spice level and sauce. The Boiling Crab seafood boil comes with classic additions like potatoes, corn, and sausages. Diners can also choose from sides like sweet potato fries and steamed rice to round out their meal.

Seafood Boil: Dive Into Deliciousness

The heart of the Boiling Crab menu is their seafood boil, where you can mix and match your favorite seafood and pair it with your choice of sauces and sides. The seafood is served shell-on and packed with flavor. Whether you’re a fan of shrimp, snow crab, or mussels, there’s a boil combination for everyone.

Popular Seafood Boil Options:

  • Peel-and-Eat Shrimp: Tossed in your choice of sauce and spice level, these shrimp are boiled to perfection.
  • Crawfish: Available seasonally, these flash-frozen crawfish are a fan favorite.
  • Snow Crab Legs: Sweet and tender, the snow crab legs are a must-try for crab lovers.
  • King Crab Legs: If you’re feeling indulgent, the king crab is rich, succulent, and sure to satisfy.

Sauces: Flavorful and Spicy

Boiling Crab is known for its signature sauces, which add a burst of flavor to their seafood boils. Whether you like it mild, spicy, or somewhere in between, you can choose your desired level of heat and enjoy the perfect combination of spices.

Popular Sauce Options:

  • Whole Sha-Bang Sauce: A mix of Cajun spices, lemon pepper, and garlic butter for the ultimate flavor explosion.
  • Lemon Pepper: A zesty blend of fresh lemon and cracked black pepper, ideal for those who like a citrusy twist.
  • Garlic Butter: Rich and buttery, this sauce adds a smooth garlic flavor to any seafood.

Seafood Baskets: Fried to Perfection

For those who prefer their seafood fried, Boiling Crab also offers seafood baskets, which include options like fried shrimp and fried catfish. These baskets are served with crispy Cajun fries or sweet potato fries and are perfect for a quick meal or appetizer.

Popular Basket Options:

  • Fried Shrimp Basket: Lightly battered and fried to golden perfection, served with Cajun fries.
  • Fried Catfish Basket: Crispy fried catfish fillets paired with tangy dipping sauces.
  • Fried Oyster Basket: Plump and juicy fried oysters, served with a side of fries.

Seafood Basket Pricing Table

Sides: Complement Your Seafood Feast

No seafood boil is complete without the perfect sides. Boiling Crab offers a variety of classic sides like corn on the cob, potatoes, and sausages, which pair perfectly with their seafood dishes. Other popular options include sweet potato fries and steamed rice.

Popular Sides:

  • Corn on the Cob: A sweet, buttery addition to any seafood boil.
  • Sausage: Savory, smoky sausages that complement the Cajun flavors of the seafood.
  • Steamed Rice: Fluffy rice that’s perfect for soaking up the delicious sauces.
  • Sweet Potato Fries: Crispy and slightly sweet, these fries are a popular choice.

Crab and Lobster: Seafood Royalty

Craving something luxurious? The lobster and crab legs at Boiling Crab are a must-try. The king crab and snow crab legs are packed with tender meat and served with your choice of sauce, while the lobster is sweet and succulent, perfect for seafood lovers.

Ordering and Delivery Options

Craving seafood but don’t want to leave the house? Boiling Crab makes it easy to order online and get your food delivered straight to your door. You can place your order through the Boiling Crab website or third-party apps like Postmates or Uber Eats. Track your order in real-time and enjoy your seafood feast in the comfort of your own home.

How to Order:

  1. Visit the Boiling Crab website or app.
  2. Select your location and browse the menu.
  3. Add your favorite items to the cart.
  4. Choose delivery or takeout options.
  5. Pay online and track your order.

Delivery Fees: Delivery fees typically range from $2.99 to $6.99 depending on your location and the delivery platform you use.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does Boiling Crab offer delivery?

Yes, Boiling Crab offers delivery through their website and third-party apps like Postmates and Uber Eats. You can also choose takeout from your nearest location.

2. What are the most popular items at Boiling Crab?

Some of the most popular items at Boiling Crab include the Peel-and-Eat Shrimp, Snow Crab Legs, and their famous Whole Sha-Bang Sauce.

3. Can I customize the spice level of my order?

Yes, you can choose your spice level when ordering at Boiling Crab, from mild to extra spicy.

4. What are the different sauce options at Boiling Crab?

The most popular sauces include Whole Sha-Bang, Garlic Butter, and Lemon Pepper.

5. Does Boiling Crab offer any gluten-free options?

Many of Boiling Crab’s seafood items are naturally gluten-free, but it’s always best to check with the restaurant to confirm.

Restaurant Timings

The operating hours for Boiling Crab vary by location, but the general schedule for most venues is as follows:

  • Monday to Friday: 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM
  • Saturday to Sunday: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM

Be sure to check your local Boiling Crab location for specific hours of operation.

With this detailed guide to the Boiling Crab menu, you’re now ready to satisfy your seafood cravings. Whether you’re looking for a rich seafood boil, flavorful sauces, or a fried seafood basket, Boiling Crab has something to offer. Explore the full menu, place your order online, and enjoy the best of Cajun-inspired seafood delivered to your door!
